scope: All 10 findings and all 430 per-problem suggestions from the 179-problem review.

findings.title: Use exact comparisons for integer-answer contracts
findings.resolution: Integer expectations compare exactly even for float results; medians explicitly retain numeric tolerances through browser JSON. Scalar, nested and browser regressions reject the old float mutant.

findings.title: Require nondecreasing factor lists before normalizing outer order
findings.resolution: Factor combinations require nondecreasing inner lists while retaining arbitrary outer order; descending, malformed and duplicate candidates are tested.

findings.title: One immediate round trip accepts a Codec whose string does not encode the tree
findings.resolution: Tree Codec strings decode with fresh class/global state, survive later serialization, reconstruct independent nodes, and reject constant/cache-token shortcuts. Additional judge probes are excluded from learner traces.

findings.title: Valid linked lists above 10000 nodes cannot be serialized
findings.resolution: Linked-list serialization supports 50000 nodes while retaining cycle/oversize rejection. Both 10001 and 50000-node valid Sort List cases are exercised, including 50000 in Pyodide.

findings.title: Distinguish the largest pair sum from the anchored triple sum
findings.resolution: 3Sum walkthrough arithmetic explicitly includes its anchor.

findings.title: Remove impossible overlap-chain example under disjoint input constraints
findings.resolution: Insert Interval explains the contiguous overlap block without the impossible disjoint-interval chain scenario.

findings.title: Correct the reversed negative-prefix intuition
findings.resolution: Maximum Subarray correctly explains that negative prefixes make extending worse than restarting.

findings.title: Include the scan of k input heads in the runtime bound
findings.resolution: Merge K Sorted Lists includes the initial k-head scan in O(k + N log(k+1)) time.

findings.title: Sorted output adds a logarithmic factor to the taught linear traversal
findings.resolution: Pacific Atlantic emits deterministic row-major results using a linear membership scan; explanation and exact code notes match O(RC).

findings.title: Correctness warning misstates the effect of reversing duplicate pruning
findings.resolution: Permutations II explains the wasted partial branches from reversed duplicate pruning without claiming it loses valid completed permutations.
